q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
Let me work through this systematically.

## (a) Time left until resolution

Today is 2026-08-25. The earnings release is scheduled for Wednesday, August 26, 2026 after market close. This means resolution occurs in approximately **24 hours** — essentially tomorrow. This is an extremely short forecast window.

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

The question asks for NVIDIA's **forward guidance** in Q2 FY2027 earnings. Based on the research provided, NVIDIA has already issued guidance for Q2 FY2027:

- **NVIDIA's own guidance: $91.0 billion ± 2%** (range: $89.2B - $92.8B)
- Wall Street consensus: $91.8-$91.9 billion

Since the earnings call is tomorrow and NVIDIA has already announced its forward guidance, the "forward guidance in Q2 FY2027 earnings release" almost certainly refers to NVIDIA's **Q3 FY2027 guidance**, which will be announced tomorrow. This is standard practice — companies provide guidance for the upcoming quarter during earnings calls.

The research indicates:
- UBS expects Q3 guidance around $107-108 billion
- Sequential growth has been slowing (Q1 added $13.5B sequentially, Q2 added $9.4B)
- The question range provided (99.5-115.5B) encompasses and exceeds the UBS estimate

The most likely scenario is that NVIDIA guides Q3 FY2027 revenue in the $105-110 billion range, reflecting:
- Strong but moderating growth trajectory
- Continued AI/data center demand
- Market expectations already partially priced in at ~$107-108B

## (c) What would push the value lower?

- Unexpected weakness in AI data center demand
- Macro economic deterioration
- More significant China revenue restrictions than currently assumed
- Competitive pressures materializing faster than expected
- Conservative management guidance relative to market expectations

The range floor of $99.5B would require guidance well below current expectations.

## (d) What would push the value higher?

- Better-than-expected data center demand
- Upside from new product launches or applications
- Market share gains from competitors
- Macro tailwinds or euphoric AI adoption acceleration
- Management confidence to guide above current consensus

The range ceiling of $115.5B would require guidance significantly above UBS's $107-108B estimate.

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

From the research provided:
- NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 guidance: $91.0B ± 2% ($89.2-92.8B)
- UBS Q3 FY2027 expectation: $107-108B
- Recent sequential additions: Q1 +$13.5B, Q2 +$9.4B

No reliable historical base rate for NVIDIA's forward guidance patterns is provided in the research.

## Analysis

Given that:
1. The earnings call is literally tomorrow
2. UBS specifically expects $107-108B for Q3 guidance
3. The range provided ($99.5-115.5B) centers roughly around $107.5B
4. Analyst consensus on what NVIDIA will guide appears fairly tight
5. NVIDIA typically provides guidance within reasonable bounds of market expectations

The distribution should peak around the $107-108B estimate with reasonable variance to either side. I'll model this as approximately normal around $107.5B with standard deviation of ~$3-4B to account for typical guidance variation and the possibility of beats/misses.

q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA is scheduled to release its Q2 FY2027 earnings on Wednesday, August 26, 2026, after the U.S. market close, with the analyst call following at 2 p.m. PT [piptheory.com](https://piptheory.com/research/nvidia-q2-fy2027-earnings-preview-august-2026).

The company's own guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue is approximately $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%, implying a range of $89.2 billion to $92.8 billion [ig.com](https://www.ig.com/en-ch/news-and-trade-ideas/nvidia-q2-fy2027-earnings-preview--what-to-watch-260825), [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/), [piptheory.com](https://piptheory.com/research/nvidia-q2-fy2027-earnings-preview-august-2026). This guidance assumes no data center compute revenue from China [ig.com](https://www.ig.com/en-ch/news-and-trade-ideas/nvidia-q2-fy2027-earnings-preview--what-to-watch-260825), [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/), [piptheory.com](https://piptheory.com/research/nvidia-q2-fy2027-earnings-preview-august-2026). Wall Street consensus revenue is slightly higher at $91.8 billion to $91.9 billion, with EPS around $2.08-$2.09 [ig.com](https://www.ig.com/en-ch/news-and-trade-ideas/nvidia-q2-fy2027-earnings-preview--what-to-watch-260825), [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/), [piptheory.com](https://piptheory.com/research/nvidia-q2-fy2027-earnings-preview-august-2026).

Analysts suggest the Q3 outlook will be more impactful than the Q2 beat itself [ig.com](https://www.ig.com/en-ch/news-and-trade-ideas/nvidia-q2-fy2027-earnings-preview--what-to-watch-260825), with UBS reportedly expecting a Q3 guide of $107-108 billion [aliteq.com](https://aliteq.com/nvidia-q2-fy27-earnings-preview-ubs-2026). The guided Q2 sequential revenue add of $9.4 billion is lower than the $13.5 billion added in Q1 [piptheory.com](https://piptheory.com/research/nvidia-q2-fy2027-earnings-preview-august-2026).
